title: PRESS RELEASE: Omoi Announces New Series Love Is the Sweetest Journey, A Snow Fox at the Northern Fort Print Edition, and 40+ Series Coming to Premium

body_markdown:
**From Titan Manga and Manga Mavericks Books, the new additions include *Sanda* , *Record Journey* , *The Elegant Courtly Life of the Tea Witch* , and *Vegetable Sandwich* .**


NEW YORK, NY—At their industry panel at Anime NYC 2026, manga platform and publisher[Omoi](https://email.omoi.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMDc1NTcsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5vbW9pLmNvbT91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsXHUwMDI2dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcmVzcyIsInQiOjE3ODc0MTQwMDd9/186346373d71480745bcf27db60e547b8a50c4485aaf171e225b3e01aecfe808) announced that they have licensed the travel-themed romantic comedy series *Love Is the Sweetest Journey* by Momoshiro and Tomoko Mitsuki for exclusive digital distribution on their platform. The company also announced one of their digital titles coming to print via a partnership with Scholastic Graphix: *A Snow Fox at the Northern Fort* . Starting today, Omoi’s Premium subscription will also add 45 titles from Titan Manga, including *Sanda* , *Record Journey* , and *The Elegant Courtly Life of the Tea Witch* , and will add *Vegetable Sandwich* from Manga Mavericks Books on September 29, 2026.


Japanese Cover – Not Final


[Love Is the Sweetest Journey](https://email.omoi.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMDc1NTcsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5vbW9pLmNvbS9zZXJpZXMvbG92ZS1pcy10aGUtc3dlZXRlc3Qtam91cm5leT91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsXHUwMDI2dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcmVzcyIsInQiOjE3ODc0MTQwMDd9/05f96ecb4a3dbf78584ae41f099d7f9bf083266315bbfce3188de33c5c7b03e2) is a 2023 romantic comedy manga written by Momoshiro ( *Do as the Wolf Prince Commands!* , *My Sadistic Boyfriend* ) with art by Tomoko Mitsuki. It was originally serialized under the name *Tabi wa Ui Mono Amai Mono* in the josei manga (women’s comic) magazine *Seasons* , published by Bungeishunju. Omoi will begin releasing English chapters in 2027, with chapters available exclusively through the Omoi Premium digital subscription. The synopsis is as follows:


> Suzune was just about to turn 30 when her boyfriend of three years dumped her, and admitted he had been cheating the whole time! Furious and depressed, she heads to Miyazaki Prefecture to cleanse her soul while filming videos for her travel-themed social channel. There she meets Yuujin, a mysterious young novelist struggling with writer’s block. After a drunken night together, Yuujin realizes Suzune might be just the inspiration he needs, and asks her an unexpected question: “will you travel with me?” A delightfully sweet romantic travelogue about discovering new places together, featuring real locations throughout Japan!


[A Snow Fox at the Northern Fort](https://email.omoi.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMDc1NTcsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5vbW9pLmNvbS9zZXJpZXMvYS1zbm93LWZveC1hdC10aGUtbm9ydGhlcm4tZm9ydD91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsXHUwMDI2dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcmVzcyIsInQiOjE3ODc0MTQwMDd9/bb44e047271c3804f731b0c2b66f84083552c2a7cef19bb9093a091655167a5f) is a 2020 fantasy manga series with art by Tawa Akeno and based on the light novels by Tsukasa Mikuni and character design by Sochu. Omoi began digitally serializing the series in 2026. Scholastic’s Graphix imprint will release the series in black-and-white print editions starting in fall 2027. The synopsis is as follows:


> An ordinary young woman is reincarnated in another world as Milphyria, a tiny snow spirit in the guise of a fox in the snowy mountains of the north. When her mother leaves for the capital on an important mission and tells Mil to stay home alone, loneliness sends Mil wandering away from home — and straight into a fort full of tough-guy knights! They seem intimidating at first, but the one-eyed vice-commander with a scar on his face takes a liking to Mil and helps her, leading her to find a new home at the fort. A wholesome, heartwarming tale of the bonds woven between an adorable fluffball protagonist and a colorful cast of knights


In addition, Omoi announced 45 titles from[Titan Manga](https://email.omoi.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMDc1NTcsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3RpdGFuLWNvbWljcy5jb20vbWFuZ2E_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbFx1MDAyNnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJlc3MiLCJ0IjoxNzg3NDE0MDA3fQ/7b6cbd000f181853d9c18e7a58b7fa1d319264ccdb0d920d004762190d323365) (an imprint of Titan Comics) arriving on the platform in the coming weeks. Early volumes from three titles — *Sanda* , *Record Journey* , and *The Elegant Courtly Life of the Tea Witch* — are available today, and the full catalog will be available in the coming weeks. All of these series will be available to read in full via an Omoi Premium subscription. Manga fans can also purchase volumes directly, with Premium members getting 20% off all volume purchases. Finally, Omoi announced that the upcoming series[Vegetable Sandwich](https://email.omoi.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMDc1NTcsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5vbW9pLmNvbS9zZXJpZXMvdmVnZXRhYmxlLXNhbmR3aWNoP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWxcdTAwMjZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByZXNzIiwidCI6MTc4NzQxNDAwN30/42887c9aa3e2666b54ae56881c1a8dc54a978438c1e3a197fee35c63481d32f8) by Banjo Saitou and published in English by[Manga Mavericks Books](https://email.omoi.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMDc1NTcsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3N0b3JlLm1hbmdhbWF2ZXJpY2tzLmNvbS8_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbFx1MDAyNnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJlc3MiLCJ0IjoxNzg3NDE0MDA3fQ/c3332f71db176692314a63730f881faf84d7b2afd681d2723a1879c27da989da) will be available via Omoi Premium on September 29, 2026. Manga Mavericks describes the series:


> High school student Tsukushi has got the look of a thug, but he has one pressing issue: he’s a weakling through and through.
>
>
> Sure, he has the earnestness to learn, but that can only take a person so far. Warabi, on the other hand, is a crazy strong elementary school student but doesn’t have anyone she considers a friend. A chance encounter with a lion escaping from a zoo brings the two together, where they realize that despite their myriad of differences, they have plenty in common too. If anyone can be a student in the pursuit of strength, can anyone also be a teacher?
>
>
> With art inspired by 80’s shonen manga, this is a vegetable you’ll not only want to enjoy first but all the way till the last bite!


****About Omoi and KiraKira Media Inc.****


Omoi is a digital comics publisher and subscription app specializing in translated Japanese manga, run by a small team of manga fans and tech experts at KiraKira Media Inc. in San Francisco, CA.


Omoi is available on the web at[omoi.com](https://email.omoi.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMDc1NTcsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwOi8vb21vaS5jb20_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbFx1MDAyNnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJlc3MiLCJ0IjoxNzg3NDE0MDA3fQ/f5332ef5817266bd70f97263e591afc2fd189acca7e3176a8ffb52949540ddbe) and in the iOS App Store and Google Play Store. The app features over 1,500 manga series, with new chapters updated daily. Manga fans can start reading for free with advertisements today, or upgrade to Premium to unlock thousands of chapters from more than 600 series for $4.99 a month. A 14-day free trial and discounted annual plan are also available, and additional volumes and chapters outside the subscription are available for purchase. Most titles are available worldwide (except Japan). Omoi also releases print editions of their titles through partnerships with Scholastic’s Graphix and Penguin Random House’s Ink Pop.
